paper.title_en: Photoproduction of <math><mrow><msup><mi>K</mi><mn>0</mn></msup><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">Σ</mi><mo>+</mo></msup></mrow></math> off protons in the resonance region
paper.abstract_en: We analyze the <math><mrow><mi>γ</mi><mi>p</mi><mo>→</mo><msup><mi>K</mi><mn>0</mn></msup><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">Σ</mi><mo>+</mo></msup></mrow></math> process in the resonance region within the framework of the isobar model. The amplitude is constructed as a sum of tree-level Feynman diagrams with the addition of the contact current ensuring gauge invariance of the total amplitude. The resonance content of our models is inspired by a model for the isospin-related <math><mrow><msup><mi>K</mi><mo>+</mo></msup><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">Σ</mi><mn>0</mn></msup></mrow></math> channel. The main coupling constant in the <math><mrow><mi>K</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">Σ</mi><mi>N</mi></mrow></math> vertex is estimated with the help of isospin symmetry, and the rest of the free parameters (resonance couplings and hadronic form-factor cutoffs) are calibrated to the available <math><mrow><msup><mi>K</mi><mn>0</mn></msup><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">Σ</mi><mo>+</mo></msup></mrow></math> data. Using the resulting models, we calculate the differential and total cross sections as well as polarization observables <math><mo>(</mo><mi>P</mi></math>, <math><mi mathvariant="normal">Σ</mi></math>, <math><mi>T</mi></math>, <math><msub><mi>O</mi><mi>x</mi></msub></math>, <math><msub><mi>O</mi><mi>z</mi></msub><mo>)</mo></math>, and compare them with measurements. We identify the <math><mrow><mi>N</mi><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>1720</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>/</mo><msup><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo></msup></mrow></math> and <math><mrow><mi>N</mi><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>1900</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>/</mo><msup><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo></msup></mrow></math> states as the most important ones for good correspondence with the experimental data.
